name: reader-card
title: Reader Card
description: A story card that scrolls in place and morphs into a liquid-glass reader.
docs:
Reader Card — A story card that scrolls in place and morphs into a liquid-glass reader.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Newsreader (variable, with its optical-size axis, and italic) for the titles and the reader, Times New Roman for the card's excerpt (Tinos where it is missing) and Inter for the small labels. The stylesheet reads --font-newsreader and --font-tinos when they are set, as next/font sets them, and otherwise falls back to faces named "Newsreader" and "Tinos". If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

reader-card-glass.ts is the liquid glass and must sit beside the component. The full refraction is a backdrop-filter: url() SVG filter, which only Chromium renders; Safari and Firefox get a frosted glass with the same baked rim light on their own. The reader opens inside the scene rather than over your page, so give the scene the room you want the panel to take, or pass fill. If something floats over its foot, set --prc-inset-bottom on a parent to keep the panel above it. Its story is built in: swap the text in ReaderCard.tsx for your own, keeping the excerpt's first passage and the marked lines in step with the card's.
